focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞：伺服器、製造景氣與工廠投資
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asia: servers, manufacturing sentiment and factory investment

throughline.zh: 戴爾公布伺服器營收與全年財測，台經院更新製造業調查，美國則正式刊出影響東南亞三地供應鏈的許可規則。
throughline.en: Dell reported server revenue and revised its guidance, TIER released its manufacturing survey, and the U.S. published a licensing rule covering entities in three Southeast Asian destinations.

text.zh: 戴爾上季 AI 最佳化伺服器營收年增 291% 至 220.31 億美元，全年該類伺服器財測上修至 780 億美元。
text.en: Dell’s quarterly AI-optimized server revenue rose 291% to US$22.03 billion. It raised full-year guidance for the category to US$78 billion.

text.zh: 美國正式刊登東南亞 7 家實體的列名規則，載明 11 月 23 日生效及特定在途貨物的過渡條款。
text.en: The U.S. published its rule for seven Southeast Asian Entity List additions, specifying a November 23 effective date and a transit provision.

text.zh: 台經院 10 月製造業營業氣候測驗點降至 98.94，電子機械業當月看好者仍多於看壞者。
text.en: TIER’s October manufacturing business climate index fell to 98.94, while positive current readings still outnumbered negative ones in electronics and machinery.

text.zh: 越南海防稀土材料廠動土，規劃年產 1 萬噸，目標 2028 年第四季商轉。
text.en: A rare earth materials plant broke ground in Hai Phong with 10,000 tonnes of annual design capacity and a Q4 2028 commercial launch target.

text.zh: 國科會披露台大下一代 Transformer 晶片已於 10 月以 16 奈米製程下線，實測能效尚未公開。
text.en: The NSTC disclosed an October 16 nm tape-out for NTU’s next Transformer chip. Measured energy efficiency is still undisclosed.

title.zh: 戴爾上季 AI 伺服器營收增至 220.31 億美元，全年財測上修
title.en: Dell reports US$22.03 billion in quarterly AI server revenue and raises annual guidance

summary.zh: 戴爾科技 11 月 24 日在美國公布 2027 會計年度第三季財報，AI 最佳化伺服器營收 220.31 億美元，年增 291%，集團營收 549.37 億美元，年增 103%。戴爾公開供應商名單列緯創新竹湖口與竹北廠供應伺服器及印刷電路板組裝件。
summary.en: Dell Technologies reported fiscal Q3 2027 results in the U.S. on November 24. AI-optimized server revenue rose 291% year over year to US$22.03 billion and group revenue rose 103% to US$54.94 billion. Dell lists Wistron’s Hukou and Zhubei sites in Taiwan for servers and printed circuit board assemblies.

text.zh: 戴爾將 AI 最佳化伺服器、傳統伺服器與網通、儲存分列在基礎架構解決方案事業群。該事業群營收為 419.74 億美元，年增 198%，營業利益為 71.18 億美元，年增 308%。
text.en: Dell reports AI-optimized servers, traditional servers and networking, and storage separately within its Infrastructure Solutions Group. The segment recorded US$41.97 billion in revenue, up 198%, and US$7.12 billion in operating income, up 308%.

text.zh: 集團按美國會計準則計算的毛利率為 21.0%，去年同期為 20.7%，淨利為 56.73 億美元，年增 266%。稀釋每股盈餘為 8.82 美元，調整後為 9.45 美元，分別年增 287% 與 265%。戴爾稱當季接獲 602 億美元 AI 訂單，季末在手訂單 1,323 億美元，並將全年營收財測從 1,920 億上修至 2,020 億美元，AI 最佳化伺服器營收財測從 740 億上修至 780 億美元。
text.en: GAAP gross margin rose to 21.0% from 20.7%, and net income rose 266% to US$5.67 billion. Diluted EPS rose 287% to US$8.82 and adjusted EPS rose 265% to US$9.45. Dell reported US$60.2 billion in quarterly AI orders and a US$132.3 billion quarter-end backlog. It raised full-year revenue guidance to US$202 billion from US$192 billion and AI-optimized server revenue guidance to US$78 billion from US$74 billion.

title.zh: 追蹤｜美國正式刊登東南亞 7 家實體列名規則，明列在途貨物過渡條款
title.en: Follow-up | U.S. publishes Entity List rule for seven Southeast Asian entities with a transit provision

summary.zh: 美國《聯邦公報》11 月 25 日正式刊登將馬來西亞、新加坡與泰國目的地下 7 家實體列入管制名單的規則，文件載明生效日是 11 月 23 日。規則保留特定在途貨物的過渡安排，符合條件的交易須於 12 月 23 日或以前完成。
summary.en: The U.S. Federal Register published a rule on November 25 listing seven entities under Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand. It specifies a November 23 effective date and a transition provision for qualifying shipments already in transit, which must be completed by December 23.

text.zh: 美國商務部工業與安全局把三家列在馬來西亞、三家列在新加坡、一家列在泰國。規則涵蓋適用美國《出口管理規則》的項目，列名實體適用許可要求，審查採推定拒絕。
text.en: The Bureau of Industry and Security lists three entities under Malaysia, three under Singapore and one under Thailand. The rule applies a license requirement and a presumption of denial to items subject to the U.S. Export Administration Regulations.

text.zh: 在途條款限於 11 月 23 日已依實際訂單裝載於承運工具、正前往相關出口、再出口或境內轉移地點，且原先符合免許可或許可例外條件的貨物。馬來西亞投資、貿易及工業部 11 月 24 日表示其中兩家是馬來西亞實體，與美方按目的地編排的口徑不同。
text.en: The transit provision applies to items already aboard a carrier en route on November 23 under actual orders and previously eligible for a license exception or shipment without a license. Malaysia’s trade ministry said on November 24 that two firms were Malaysian entities, a different classification from the U.S. list by destination.

title.zh: 台經院 10 月製造業測驗點降至 98.94，電子機械業當月看好者仍多於看壞
title.en: Taiwan manufacturing sentiment falls to 98.94 as more electronics firms report good than poor conditions

summary.zh: 台灣經濟研究院 11 月 25 日公布，10 月製造業營業氣候測驗點降至 98.94，較 9 月修正值低 2.85 點。台經院指出，電子機械業受訪者看好當月景氣者仍多於看壞者，並提及 AI 晶片、DRAM 與先進封裝需求。
summary.en: The Taiwan Institute of Economic Research reported on November 25 that its October manufacturing sentiment index fell 2.85 points from revised September to 98.94. In its electronics and machinery grouping, more respondents reported good than poor current conditions. The institute cited AI chips, DRAM and advanced packaging demand.

text.zh: 台經院依製造業問卷的當月與未來半年評價編製測驗點，9 月修正值為 101.79。10 月製造業受訪者評當月景氣為好的比率從 27.7% 降至 19.2%，評為壞的比率從 18.7% 升至 21.5%。
text.en: The institute models its index from manufacturers’ responses about the current month and the coming six months. It revised September to 101.79. In October, 19.2% rated current conditions good, down from 27.7%, while 21.5% rated them poor, up from 18.7%.

text.zh: 台經院指出，晶圓代工、DRAM 製造及半導體封測帶動電子機械業當月景氣，化纖、汽機車與自行車業的受訪者看法相對偏弱。對未來半年，整體製造業看好比率從 24.3% 降至 21.4%，看壞比率從 17.7% 升至 19.6%。
text.en: The institute cited foundries, DRAM manufacturing, packaging and testing for the electronics and machinery results, while synthetic fibers, motor vehicles and bicycles reported weaker sentiment. Across manufacturing, the six-month positive share fell to 21.4% from 24.3% and the negative share rose to 19.6% from 17.7%.

title.zh: 界霖說明伺服器電源銅夾與功率模組開發方向
title.en: Jih Lin details copper clip and power module development for server power supplies

summary.zh: 台灣導線架廠界霖科技 11 月 24 日在線上法說會說明銅夾與功率模組的開發方向，媒體引述公司表示，產品開發涵蓋 AI 伺服器電源。公司簡報將銅夾與功率模組列在精密金屬沖壓與電鍍的開發項目。
summary.en: Taiwan leadframe maker Jih Lin Technology discussed copper clips and power module development at an online investor conference on November 24. Local media cited the company as targeting AI server power supplies, and the presentation listed clips and power modules within its precision stamping and plating strategy.

text.zh: 據經濟日報引述，界霖以大面積銅片作為模組內部連接件，因應功率晶片薄型化與雙面冷卻設計。公司簡報列有台灣生產據點與馬來西亞子公司 SH Precision。
text.en: The Economic Daily News quoted Jih Lin as describing a wider copper connection inside modules designed for thinner power chips and double-sided cooling. Its presentation identifies production in Taiwan and a Malaysian subsidiary, SH Precision.

text.zh: 法說重點是開發路線。簡報亦回顧 2026 年第三季合併財務資料，其中營收較去年同期成長 23%，為公司整體業績。
text.en: The investor briefing outlined product development. Its slides also recapped fiscal Q3 2026 consolidated results, including 23% year-over-year revenue growth for the company as a whole.

title.zh: Khánh An 在越南海防動工興建稀土材料廠，規劃年產能 1 萬噸
title.en: Khánh An breaks ground on Hai Phong rare earth materials plant designed for 10,000 tonnes a year

summary.zh: 越南 Khánh An 工業 11 月 23 日在海防市春橋工業及非關稅區為高純度稀土材料廠動土，海防市公布投資額為 1.58 兆越南盾。市府稱專案規劃以 5 條產線供應電子、半導體和新能源產業，目標於 2028 年第四季商轉。
summary.en: Vietnam’s Khánh An Industry broke ground on a high-purity rare earth materials plant at Hai Phong’s Xuan Cau Industrial and Non-Tariff Zone on November 23. The city disclosed VND1.58 trillion in investment and a plan for five lines serving electronics, semiconductors and new energy, with commercial operation targeted for Q4 2028.

text.zh: 海防市財政部門說，廠房規劃以濕法冶金與萃取製造單一稀土氧化物，設計年產能 1 萬噸，目標純度逾 99%。路透報導，原料預計包括越南老街省 Ben Den 礦區的混合稀土氧化物。
text.en: Hai Phong’s finance department said the plant would use hydrometallurgy and extraction to produce individual rare earth oxides, with design capacity of 10,000 tonnes a year and purity above 99%. Reuters reported that feedstock would include mixed rare earth oxides from the Ben Den mine in Lao Cai province.

text.zh: 海防市同步公布瀝縣港碼頭動工。前述 1.58 兆越南盾為 Khánh An 材料廠投資額，碼頭另列為不同投資案。
text.en: Hai Phong also announced a groundbreaking for berths at Lach Huyen port. The VND1.58 trillion covers the Khánh An materials plant, a separate investment from the port berths.

title.zh: 越南峴港核發 Arbin Energy 儲能與電池測試設備廠投資登記證
title.en: Da Nang issues investment certificate for Arbin’s energy storage and battery test plant

summary.zh: 越南峴港媒體 11 月 23 日報導，園區管理機關已核發 Arbin Energy 峴港高科技園區工廠的投資登記證，總投資折合約 1.17 億美元。工廠計畫生產電網級電池儲能系統，以及電池測試與製造設備。
summary.en: Báo Đà Nẵng reported on November 23 that the local industrial zones authority had issued an investment certificate for Arbin Energy’s US$117 million factory at Da Nang Hi-Tech Park. The project plans to make grid-scale battery storage systems, battery testers and battery manufacturing equipment.

text.zh: 報導引述園區資料，電池儲能系統全案設計年產 5,000 個貨櫃，折合 5GWh，另規劃每年 500 台電池測試設備及 800 台電池製造設備。首間廠房的啟用目標是 2028 年第三季，儲能貨櫃初期年產目標較低，為 100 至 300 個。
text.en: Citing the authority, the local report gave full design capacity of 5,000 battery storage containers, equivalent to 5 GWh a year, plus 500 battery testers and 800 units of battery production equipment annually. The first building is scheduled to open in Q3 2028 with initial storage output targeted at 100 to 300 containers a year.

text.zh: 市府門戶 11 月 21 日已轉載投資原則獲准的消息，11 月 23 日報導確認登記證已核發。地方報導列投資人出資約 3,400 萬美元，其餘約 8,300 萬美元擬由金融機構籌措。
text.en: The city portal carried news of investment policy approval on November 21. The November 23 report confirmed that the registration certificate had been issued. Local reporting put investor equity at about US$34 million and planned financing from credit institutions at about US$83 million.

title.zh: 國科會披露台大下一代 Transformer 晶片 10 月已用 16 奈米製程下線
title.en: NSTC says NTU taped out next-generation 16 nm Transformer chip in October

summary.zh: 國科會 11 月 25 日在台北披露，台大楊家驤團隊的下一代 Transformer 晶片已於 10 月以 16 奈米製程下線。團隊針對生成式 AI 推論的記憶體頻寬限制，調整外部記憶體資料流與控制流程。
summary.en: Taiwan’s National Science and Technology Council disclosed in Taipei on November 25 that Chia-hsiang Yang’s NTU team taped out its next-generation Transformer chip on a 16 nm process in October. The design targets memory bandwidth limits in generative AI inference by changing external memory data flow and controls.

text.zh: 研究團隊此前兩代學習處理器發表於 2024 年與 2025 年 IEEE VLSI 技術與電路研討會。國科會指出，第一代使用 40 奈米製程，第二代改採前向傳遞學習以減少訓練期間須保存的資訊。
text.en: The team presented two earlier learning processors at the IEEE VLSI Symposium in 2024 and 2025. The NSTC said the first used a 40 nm process and the second used forward-only learning to reduce information retained during training.

text.zh: 國科會引述第二代晶片的研究測試，最高能量效率為 157 TOPS/W。該數值來自先前發表的晶片，這次披露的 16 奈米晶片則另外加入資料壓縮，重點是改善推論資料搬移。
text.en: The NSTC cited a peak 157 TOPS/W in research testing of the earlier second-generation chip. The newly disclosed 16 nm design separately uses data compression to reduce data movement during inference.

title.zh: 產發署稱已輔導 438 廠提交自主減量計畫，其中 389 廠通過審查
title.en: Taiwan reports 389 approvals among 438 facilities assisted with carbon reduction plans

summary.zh: 經濟部產業發展署 11 月 25 日在台北公布，已協助 438 家應繳碳費的工廠提交自主減量計畫，其中 389 廠通過環境部審查，取得碳費優惠資格。會中亦介紹工廠節能、智慧製造與循環材料案例。
summary.en: Taiwan’s Industrial Development Administration reported in Taipei on November 25 that it had helped 438 facilities subject to the carbon fee submit voluntary reduction plans. The environment ministry approved 389 of them for preferential rates. The conference also featured factory energy efficiency, smart manufacturing and circular materials.

text.zh: 自主減量計畫可讓通過環境部審查的適用工廠採優惠費率。產發署公布的是接受輔導的廠家進度。
text.en: Facilities with a voluntary reduction plan approved by the environment ministry can qualify for preferential fees. The IDA tally covers the facilities it assisted.

text.zh: 據產發署，製造業近十年二氧化碳排放量下降 9.6%，碳密集度下降 41.3%。產發署同場說明節能技術輔導及產業創新條例投資抵減。
text.en: The IDA said manufacturing carbon dioxide emissions fell 9.6% over roughly ten years and carbon intensity declined 41.3%. It also discussed energy efficiency support and investment credits under the Statute for Industrial Innovation.
